planner_finish.summary:
libero_goal task 2 seed 1 ("put the wine bottle on top of the cabinet") solved in one episode; top-level terminated==true at step 32.

Localization was fully perception-based: agentview_high + back_project identified the bottle lying flat on the table (base (-0.216,-0.068), neck (-0.355,-0.028)) and the cabinet's top plane at z=1.127 (region-mode 44k pixels, centroid (-0.009,-0.265), extending toward the robot), explicitly distinguished from the gray stove burner and the slatted wooden shelf.

Key finding: a scripted top-down pinch of a table-lying bottle is impossible with this hand (pads only ~0.013 m below the tip; jaws open 0.0776 m) — the knuckles stall on the table at eef z=0.913 while the pads still close on air above the neck. So the grasp was delegated to pi0_pick("pick up the wine bottle"), which lifted it by the neck (opening 0.0242); the false success flag came only from its descent heuristic. I then owned the carry: move_to waypoints at max reachable height (z~1.19) onto the cabinet top, release.

The first release landed the bottle correctly on the cabinet (verified by wrist back-projection: bottle z 1.157-1.171 on a surface at 1.126) but did not fire the predicate — its centre (0.096,-0.254) sat just outside the goal ink box (~(0.03,-0.20..-0.24) per the seed-0 reference), mainly ~5 mm too far in -y. At cabinet height a top-down neck grasp is unobstructed, so I re-grasped the cork end (qpos 0.0257 = neck diameter), slid the bottle +y/-x, and released — libero fired terminated==true.

Audit and recipe JSONL written to the episode directory.
